summary: Backend security regression mostly passes (45/45 core + 6/7 matrix). Frontend mobile auth/local/admin/member flows pass, with one transient public 502 observed. One backend security requirement still failing: allowed CORS origin is rejected.

critical.issue: CORS preflight from allowed origin https://ehpad-recall.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' and no access-control-allow-origin header.

integration_issues.issue: Transient Cloudflare 502 Host Error encountered once during Playwright run, then recovered.

action_items: Fix CORS allowlist behavior so allowed origin returns ACAO and successful preflight.
Investigate transient 502 on public preview host stability.
critical_code_review_comments: Tests in /app/backend/tests/conftest.py and /app/backend/tests/test_security_auth.py still use localhost fallback defaults; this weakens env-driven fail-fast requirements.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* residents/capsules during matrix tests; cleanup attempted in tests. Persisted fixture accounts unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL only. Reproduce CORS failure with: OPTIONS /api/residents Origin=https://ehpad-recall.preview.emergentagent.com and Access-Control-Request-Method: GET. Expect currently 400 Disallowed CORS origin.
rca_of_issue: RCA (CORS): app middleware is configured with allow_origins from CORS_ORIGINS, but runtime behavior at public endpoint rejects even configured origin. Repro: curl OPTIONS to /api/residents with allowed Origin + preflight headers -> 400 + no ACAO. Unknown origin also has no ACAO (expected). Likely mismatch at origin parsing/ingress layering or origin value normalization in deployed runtime path.
